_meta.purpose: Source of truth for which non-guaranteed (NG) contract years to mark (issue 3a, v1 Option 1: positive-confirmation).
_meta.policy: A season is marked ONLY if (a) site_Data's salary_spread codes that season 'NG' AND (b) the player-season appears below. Anything not listed stays committed even if coded NG.
_meta.matching: By nba_id when present, else by normalized name + team (for blank-id players).
_meta.granularity: One entry per player-season; players with multiple NG years (e.g. fully-NG deals) have multiple entries.
_meta.spreadNgConfirmed: true = site_Data spread currently carries the NG code (reader will fire). false = site_Data codes it RFA/$0, NOT NG, so positive-confirmation will NOT mark it until the spread carries an NG code — see BACKLOG.

entries.note: nba_id blank in site_Data — must match by name+team, must NOT silently fall through.
